svg.title: workspace system context
svg.desc: System context showing the people who use one self-hosted workspace installation, the browser extension that reports AI activity from the public AI tools, integrations and AI clients that call its API (wos_ API keys, MCP with OAuth, workflow hooks, workspace-connect on a person's computer), and the optional and required external systems it calls or is called by.
svg.text: NO SAAS · NO BILLING · NO PLATFORM ADMIN
API key · LLM API · Ollama · a computer
